compiled_state.description:
## Context

The project has audience guidance distributed across AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/README.md, and individual documents. It lacks one current-state policy that distinguishes durable records, maintained documentation, shipped help, comments, generated artifacts, and protected evidence. The audit ticket minimum-rainy-fawn approved F01 and rejected F02. F02 contained prose and punctuation restrictions. The parent epic washedup-cattish-mealworm assigns the lossless catalog relocation to F01 so F06 can remain a one-file navigation rewrite.

## Current enforcement and history

Ticket forworn-zanyish-narwhale added generated markers, two contributor tables in docs/README.md, and tests/unit/test_generated_surface_markers.py after repeated changes edited derived outputs instead of their sources. The test owns the GENERATED and GATED_HAND_AUTHORED collections. It has three table consumers. _readme_rows supports test_readme_table_matches_registry and test_readme_lists_the_hand_authored_gated_surfaces. test_readme_rows_name_the_regenerate_command reads docs/README.md directly. test_contributing_points_at_the_generated_artifacts_table asserts the old docs/README.md anchor. The module text and section comments also name docs/README.md as the inventory. This change preserves both collections, every catalog row, and all marker checks.

F01 merged through Gerrit change 2022. The merged policy included prose and punctuation requirements from rejected F02. The operator rejected that scope and prohibited narrower substitutes. This corrective patch removes every character restriction and every diction, voice, or paragraph-shape rule from F01.

## Plan

Retain docs/documentation-policy.md as the current policy for tickets, ADRs, internal documentation, external documentation, shipped help, comments, generated artifacts, and protected evidence. Define the audience, purpose, lifecycle, canonical source, use of citations, correction method, exclusions, and examples for each category. Remove the Writing rules section. Remove the Protected forms section because it implements additional restrictions from rejected F02. Do not impose a character restriction of any scope. Do not impose diction, voice, paragraph-shape, or other general prose restrictions. Preserve the approved ownership, lifecycle, canonical-source, citation, correction, generated-artifact, historical-record, exclusion, and example content. State that ticket events remain append-only. State that ADR decision substance is preserved through annotations, errata, supersession, or replacement ADRs.

Retain docs/generated-artifacts.md as the contributor inventory. Preserve the generated and parity-gated tables that moved from docs/README.md. Restore the pre-F01 descriptions for the docs/cli-reference.md, server.json, criteria_routing.json, and reviewer-prompt rows. Preserve every catalog entry, regeneration command, enforcement gate, and section order.

Keep the relocated inventory consumers in tests/unit/test_generated_surface_markers.py. Preserve the GENERATED and GATED_HAND_AUTHORED values. Keep the CONTRIBUTING.md pointer to docs/generated-artifacts.md.

Keep concise policy pointers in AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and docs/README.md. Describe the destination only as the documentation ownership and correction policy. Limit contributor guidance to ownership, canonical-source selection, and correction paths. Remove the claim that the policy defines writing requirements.

## Exclusions

- No character restrictions of any scope.
- No diction, voice, paragraph-shape, or other general prose restrictions.
- No edits to generated outputs, ADR decision substance, ticket events, historical evidence, protected evidence, or commit history.
- No repository-wide prose rewrite.
- No prose or comment validator.
- No F05 ownership descriptor, generated catalog generator, or new ADR.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The policy role table covers exactly the eight roles listed in the Plan.
- [ ] Every policy role entry provides every field listed in the Plan.
- [ ] docs/documentation-policy.md contains no character restrictions.
- [ ] docs/documentation-policy.md contains no diction, voice, paragraph-shape, or other general prose restrictions from rejected F02.
- [ ] docs/documentation-policy.md retains the approved ownership, lifecycle, canonical-source, citation, correction, generated-artifact, historical-record, exclusion, and example content.
- [ ] docs/documentation-policy.md requires ticket corrections through new append-only events.
- [ ] docs/documentation-policy.md requires ADR corrections through annotations, errata, supersession, or replacement ADRs without erasing decision substance.
- [ ] docs/documentation-policy.md contains no Protected forms section.
- [ ] AGENTS.md describes docs/documentation-policy.md as an ownership and correction policy.
- [ ] CONTRIBUTING.md limits the policy pointer to ownership, canonical-source selection, and correction paths.
- [ ] docs/README.md does not claim that the policy defines writing requirements.
- [ ] The docs/cli-reference.md, server.json, criteria_routing.json, and reviewer-prompt catalog row descriptions match their pre-F01 text.
- [ ] docs/generated-artifacts.md contains the same generated table rows that docs/README.md contained before F01, apart from the four restored descriptions named above.
- [ ] docs/generated-artifacts.md contains the same parity-gated table rows that docs/README.md contained before F01.
- [ ] The GENERATED value in tests/unit/test_generated_surface_markers.py is unchanged.
- [ ] The GATED_HAND_AUTHORED value in tests/unit/test_generated_surface_markers.py is unchanged.
- [ ] Every inventory consumer in tests/unit/test_generated_surface_markers.py reads docs/generated-artifacts.md.
- [ ] No inventory documentation in tests/unit/test_generated_surface_markers.py identifies docs/README.md as the catalog.
- [ ] The CONTRIBUTING pointer test requires docs/generated-artifacts.md.
- [ ] AGENTS.md links to docs/documentation-policy.md.
- [ ] CONTRIBUTING.md links to docs/documentation-policy.md.
- [ ] docs/README.md links to documentation-policy.md.
- [ ] CONTRIBUTING.md links to docs/generated-artifacts.md.
- [ ] No maintained file references docs/README.md#generated-artifacts after the move.
- [ ] The targeted marker test passes.
- [ ] make lint passes.
- [ ] make typecheck passes.
- [ ] The project test gate passes.
